text.p: Hansapank shareholders have approved the proposed profit distribution plan, under which a dividend of 1.25 kroons per share will be paid.
Hansapank board proposed to pay dividends worth 23.9 million kroons from the 1996 net profit of 233.6 million kroons and 1995 profit of 80.6 million kroons.
Shareholders on Saturday also approved a stock issue of 191 million kroons, under which one new share will be issued for every existing share.
Hansapank's share capital will double from its present to 382.4 million kroons after the issue.
Hansapank group had a market share of 11 percent as of 1996 in the Baltic banking market, making it the largest Baltic financial institution.
It acquired Latvian Deutsche-Lettische Bank last June and wants to start banking operations in Lithuania this year.
In Lithuania, the bank is active in leasing, investment banking and securities.
